product_name.description: Name or model of the requested product; null if unclear
product_name.title: Product Name

quantity.description: Exact numeric quantity requested; null if not specified
quantity.title: Quantity

unit_price.description: Explicit price per unit if stated; otherwise null
unit_price.title: Unit Price

is_valid_po.description: True if the text represents a valid purchase order or procurement enquiry; False if spam, irrelevant, or gibberish
is_valid_po.title: Is Valid Po

customer_name.description: Company or buyer name placing the order; null if not stated
customer_name.title: Customer Name

contact_email.description: Contact email address if explicitly present; null otherwise
contact_email.title: Contact Email

items.description: List of line items requested; empty list if none found
items.title: Items

required_date.description: Delivery deadline normalized to YYYY-MM-DD; null if missing or vague (e.g., 'ASAP')
required_date.title: Required Date

budget_amount.description: Total numeric budget without currency symbols or commas; null if not stated
budget_amount.title: Budget Amount

currency.description: ISO currency code if budget/price is stated; null if no monetary amount exists
currency.title: Currency

ambiguity_notes.description: Notes on vague deadlines, conflicting revisions, or missing critical info; null if clean
ambiguity_notes.title: Ambiguity Notes
